payload_policy: Each exact source/owner/raw/archived stream byte sequence occurs once by SHA256. Exact original gzip bytes are embedded; decoded raw lengths/hashes are checked. Large binary payloads are excluded. Restored current images are timestamped evidence, not claims that every retired ELF still exists.
